errors.evidence: The x-axis does not have a text label; it only shows the years as numerical values.
The line does not rise between 1970 and 1980; it slightly decreases from ~2.8% to ~2.75%. The value 2.9% is not reached in this period.

errors.text_span: fällt dann auf etwa 1,3% im Jahr 2000
errors.evidence: In the year 2000, the value on the line is approximately 1.6%, not 1.3%.

errors.text_span: und bleibt bis 2015 relativ stabil bei etwa 1,2%
errors.evidence: The line is not stable between 2000 and 2015; it shows a clear downward trend from ~1.6% to a minimum of ~1.3%. The value 1.2% is never reached in the chart.

errors.text_span: bevor sie bis 2020 auf etwa 1,5% ansteigt
errors.evidence: The final value in 2020 is visibly higher than 1.5%. It is approximately 1.6-1.7%.
